verdict.rationale: Floot documents its own export path: users can export the full TypeScript/React codebase, download a full SQL dump of the Postgres database on any plan, and self-host elsewhere. That covers the core of leaving in open formats. However, the evidence does not show that ALL user data is exportable, so coverage is partial rather than complete. Missing for 10: documented export of non-code/non-database data (visitor analytics, email send logs, uploaded or generated image assets, auth/user records, checkpoints), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the export and self-hosting migration actually works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
